# `silk/build/plan`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pure package requirements built with the same standard actions and deferred paths as tasks.

A package declares `pub const PLAN: Plan` in `build.silk`. The compiler evaluates the value
without effects. Generated files and processes execute later through the build graph; package
processes require dependency authorization and a supported operating-system sandbox.

Import as `Plan` with `import silk.build.plan { Plan }`.

Public declarations: 2.
